log.entry: Board generated from FEATURE_STATUS.md ground truth: 81 features + 4 foundations. Doug culls by deleting rows.
Inverted to opt-in: all 85 items deferred; Doug promotes his starters (status chip: deferred -> todo).
v1.03 done: monitor identity ported (win/monitor_identity.py, 12 checks + live probe on 3 displays). Actual ~110k/15m vs 80k-150k/1h — tokens in band, time 4x under.
v1.04 open: tray V4 upgrade — Codex exec pilot (brief docs/briefs/v1.04-tray-v4.md), Claude reviews.

v1.04 done: tray V4 + NIF_SHOWTIP upgraded in place by Codex (pilot), reviewed + probe-verified on the interactive desktop. Pattern proven: Codex writes, Claude briefs/reviews/commits. NOTE: running EsotericOS.exe predates this — lands in the next staged build.

v2.86 open: combined usage monitor. Recon (2 Sonnet agents) proved: Codex weekly-window % + resets_at in rollout JSONL (no 5h window on this plan, 75/75 files); Claude plan-% absent from disk (server-side only) but exact token burn computable from transcripts. Slice 1 = reader module via Codex exec.

v2.86 slice 1 done: win/usage_monitor.py readers + 12 fixture checks, probe verified live (Codex 2.0% weekly, resets 08-16; Claude week: ~28M fresh+out vs 7.3B cache). One review loop via codex exec resume (component split). Codex ~113k (48k+64k), Claude review ~35k. Slice 2 = panel UI.

v2.86 code complete: both slices committed (d5e66f1, b860efc), 51 checks green, EsotericOS-next.exe staged (70MB). Status stays doing until Doug eyeballs the System desk panel live. Estimate grade: 80k-150k band held only because Codex carried ~177k of writing; future rows estimate the two budgets separately.
Repaired second stale-tab clobber: v2 milestones re-derived (v2.86 joins M2), mixed state snapshotted to history, `rev` optimistic lock introduced — stale tabs can no longer save.
OpenSpan suite (the multidevice control roadmap) added as v2.M8 with 10 rows v2.87-v2.96 — it lived only in the session task list and the board misread as import-only.
v1.01 + v1.02 open as parallel Codex slices: standalone modules only, no app wiring (briefs v1.01-keyboard-interception.md, v1.02-window-tracker.md).
v1.02 done: window tracker ported (22 checks); enumeration verified on the live desktop (7 eligible, 291 invisible excluded); WinEvent hook proven with a synthetic off-screen window (30 events).
v1.01 done: keyboard interception + router ported (17 checks); LL hook proven live by an injected F15 tap (2 events, injected flag seen). M1 Foundations CLOSED — all four platform services landed.

Estimates re-graded against 5 actuals (90 rows): reference-backed ports -40% tokens (measured .40-.96x), spec-only rows +25% (v2.86 novel work ran 1.6x OVER), all times rebased to Codex-writes/Claude-reviews throughput.
v1.64 done: config store ported (35 checks incl. a frozen-build path defect Claude caught in review and fixed). 31 suites green.
v1.60 done: plugin system ported (69 checks) - manifest validation, API negotiation, capability intersection, fault containment, discovery that never imports. 31 suites green.
